key.name: history-limit
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned history items
key.description: Oldest unpinned items are removed once this limit is exceeded. Pinned items are never counted against it. The preferences window only offers 100, 250, 500 and 1000; other in-range values are accepted and snapped to the nearest of those on the next write.

key.name: save-images
key.summary: Capture images copied to the clipboard
key.description: When disabled, newly copied images are not added to history, but images already in history are kept and a plain-text representation offered alongside an ignored image is still captured normally.

key.name: recording-paused
key.description: While paused, no new text or image is captured and no image decoding is started. Existing history stays fully usable: search, restore, pin, delete and clear all keep working.

key.name: auto-paste
key.summary: Paste the selected item into the previously focused app
key.description: When enabled, choosing a history item also asks the application that was focused before LionClip opened to paste it, on sessions where this can be done safely. Restoring the item to the clipboard always happens either way; only the automatic paste step depends on this setting and on backend support (X11 in this release).
